people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

translations.web: Absalom came to the king, and said, “See now, your servant has sheep shearers. Please let the king and his servants go with your servant.”
translations.bsb: And he went to the king and said, “Your servant has just hired shearers. Will the king and his servants please come with me?”
translations.kjv: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let ➔ the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
translations.asv: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheep-shearers; let the king, I pray thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
